The '''Detective Scanner''' is a {{Rare}} item.

== Obtaining ==
A '''Detective Scanner''' can be claimed from {{NPCSprite|Detective Amog}}.

== Usage ==
{{ItemInfo
|rarity = r
|item_ability_name = Detect!
|item_ability_activation = Right Click
|item_ability_description = Invest a clue or abnormality.
|item_ability_mana_cost = 10
|item_ability_cooldown = 4s
}}
The player can right-click on any green particles surrounding objects found in the {{zone|Murder House}} to progress in [[Detective Amog]]'s reverse murder quest. The following objects in the [[Murder House]] can be investigated:
{|class="wikitable"
! Object
! Dialogue when Investigated
|-
| Flower Pot
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Flower Pot -
&7&oThis amazing bouquet has been made with love, no doubt about that.
}}
|-
| Blood
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Blood -
&7&oThis blood stain has been looked at before.
&7&oThat definitely spooked them quite a lot, perhaps they ran away.
&7&oBut where did they run...
}}
|-
| Ring
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Ring -
&7&oThis is clearly an engagement ring.
&7&oHowever, there is a curve on the front where there should be a jewel.
&7&oThis is incomplete.
}}
|-
| Fridge
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Fridge -
&7&oThe fridge is empty.
&7&oBut what are these?
&7&oBlockDash receipts?? Hundreds of them!
}}
|-
| Tall Painting
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Tall Painting -
&7&oIt looks like an abstract painting of our victim.
&7&oThey seem to be wearing a red-ish top and blue jeans.
}}
|-
| Window
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Window -
&7&oThe attacker might've escaped through this window!
&7&oOr one of the other windows!
&7&oOr through the door!
&7&oOr the chimney!!!
}}
|-
| Large Painting
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Large Painting -
&7&oA picture of the future wedding.
&7&oThis looks like the bride.
&7&oThe husband is missing from the picture of course, he will be dead by then...
&7&oUnfortunately the picture is too pixelated to recognize the wife.
}}
|-
| Letter
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Letter -
&7&oA love letter!
&7&oIt appears that they are engaged.
&7&oWhat a tragedy...
&7&oThey might have gone to warn their love of their incoming murder.
}}
|}
Examining all eight objects will allow the player to speak to {{NPCSprite|Detective Amog}} to continue the quest. The following message will be sent as well:
{{Dialogue|
&aYou've examined all the clues!
&eTalk to the detective.
}}

Later in the quest, the player is tasked with scanning the room again:
{|class="wikitable"
! Object
! Dialogue when Investigated
|-
| Large Painting
| {{Dialogue|
&a- Large Painting -
&7&oThe wedding dress in that picture is fresh, it was just made.
&7&oYou can tell by the pixels.
&eTalk to the detective again.
}}
|}
